latest_featured_news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice
confirmed_details: The original score is composed by Justice.
The score album is scheduled for December 11, 2026.
Rockstar says the album contains 30 tracks plus digital bonus tracks.

confirmed_details: The Launch Trailer features music from Justice.
Rockstar reiterates the November 19, 2026 release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
